blocks.html: We have shown above that the sequestration of goods, and still more of persons, is odious and prohibited, unless it be for some great and legitimate cause, such as is in this case the fear of seduction and subornation. a

notes.citation: Digest 43.30.3.4 (De liberis exhibendis, item ducendis, l. 3, within § 4 Iulianus ait, at the words Si vero utraque persona suspecta est; the print's sign before ſi verò is read as §); Decretals, X 2.13 (De restitutione spoliatorum), c. 8 Ex transmissa (printed ex tranmiſſa) and c. 13 Litteras; Decretals, X 2.19.14 (De probationibus, penultimate chapter, Causam matrimonii)
notes.original: l. iij. §. ſi ve rò vtraque. D. de lib. exhib. c. ex tran miſſa. c. literas de reſtit. ſpol. c. penul. de probã.
